$comment: TASK-045 Q3 (recommended default, applied). A skip inside an otherwise-passing suite fails it unless named here with a reason and a maxCount (summed per suite by lib/skips.mjs#allowedSkipsForSuite). An all-skipped suite fails regardless of this file (lib/guard.mjs evaluateSuite rule 5). Adding an entry here is a real grant, not a formality -- name the exact file and why it cannot run in this suite. An entry with `platforms` (process.platform values) grants its budget only there: a skip that only exists on Windows must not stay spendable on the Linux runner, where it would hide a real one; an entry without it is granted everywhere.

entries.reason: gated on NATS_TEST_URL (describeIf); the real proof against a live NATS JetStream server runs in the integration suite via `make test-ports-nats`, which asserts the file's own passing-test count rather than trusting vitest's exit code (see packages/ports/scripts/nats-test.sh).
one it.skipIf(isWindows) case asserts a POSIX executable bit (0755); NTFS reports every file 0755 regardless, so the assertion cannot mean anything on a Windows unit run.
one it.skipIf(!process.env.MUSTERSTADT_RECONCILE_VERIFY) case is an opt-in reconciliation check against a real Musterstadt-shaped tenant, not part of the default acceptance run.

one it.skipIf(!canSymlinkFiles) case exercises a symlinked-file refusal; creating a symlink on Windows needs Developer Mode or elevation, so this host cannot prove the case either way. Collected via gremion-ui's vite include ('../packages/storage/src/**/*.test.ts').
same it.skipIf(!canSymlinkFiles) case as the "unit" entry above, additionally collected here because the isolation suite runs @gremion/storage's own `test` script directly.
one it.skipIf(process.platform === 'win32') case asserts the exact docker invocation used to pin the oasdiff image; the assertion is Windows-path-shape-specific and does not apply on this host.

TASK-034: two it.skipIf(!POSIX_MODE_BITS) cases assert the emitted router file's exact 0644 mode (NTFS reports no POSIX mode bits, so 'unchanged' vs 'mode repaired' cannot be told apart on win32), and one it.skipIf(!CAN_SYMLINK) case plants a symlink at the target name (needs Developer Mode or elevation on Windows). All three run on a POSIX host.
TASK-034: one it.skipIf(!POSIX_MODE_BITS) case asserts the second sync run is a no-op including file modes, which NTFS cannot report; it runs on a POSIX host.

one test is skipped unless CI_LOCAL_VERTICAL points at a checkout of a vertical, which a kernel-only runner does not have. The claim (every vertical test file is owned by a suite in scripts/ci-local/suites.json) is proven by `scripts/ci-local/snapshot.mjs --vertical <path>`, which runs the same census on every real reading against the vertical's own tree; the kernel half of the claim runs unskipped in this file.
